## ZGTA V — TrollStore installer

**Build 88 test candidate · by zema.**

Install this package in Sileo to download the exact verified IPA and pass it to your existing TrollStore or TrollStore Lite installer. It checks size and SHA-256 before installation.

Requires a compatible TrollStore setup and your own game files. An existing non-TrollStore app with the same identifier is not forcibly overwritten.

### RootHide correction — 0.88-2
The first phone test of 0.88-1 failed to locate an existing TrollStore 2.1.1 installation; it stopped before downloading the IPA. This update fixes the documented /rootfs path, accepts upstream UID 33 or root ownership, and translates the IPA path when running in RootHide.

20 local mocked installer tests and archive checks pass. Actual installation with the correction still needs a phone retest. Keep TrollStore installed; send the Sileo log if it fails.

### Updates and removal
Removing this small wrapper leaves the game and its data in place. Use TrollStore to remove the game itself. The app requires your own game files. No AppSync dependency is added to this package.

### Installer 0.88-2
- Fix RootHide helper discovery through /rootfs.
- Accept the UID 33 ownership used by upstream TrollStore, as well as UID 0.
- Convert IPA paths for RootHide mirrored-helper cases.
- Improve failure messages; do not claim TrollStore is absent when discovery fails.
- Same Build 88 IPA and dependencies; phone retest pending.

### Installer 0.88-1
- Initial Sileo → TrollStore candidate.
- Pinned Build 88 download and integrity checks.
- Native TrollStore install/custom interface; no force flag.
- Installer removal preserves the app and data.
